input.summary: Add a mutual aggregate monetary cap to Section 14.5 and extend the existing carve-outs to gross negligence, willful misconduct and fraud, while confirming Sanofi's payment obligations sit outside the cap.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 14.5 waives indirect damages but contains no monetary cap, so each Party's direct-damages exposure is unlimited; our position is a mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' payments and USD 1,000,000. Indemnification, confidentiality, IP, gross negligence, willful misconduct and fraud remain outside the cap, and Sanofi's payment obligations are not treated as capped damages.

ops.oldText: NOTWITHSTANDING THE FOREGOING, NOTHING IN THIS SECTION 14.5 IS INTENDED TO OR SHALL LIMIT OR RESTRICT THE INDEMNIFICATION RIGHTS OR OBLIGATIONS OF ANY PARTY UNDER SECTION 14.1 OR SECTION 14.2, OR DAMAGES AVAILABLE FOR A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS OBLIGATIONS RELATING TO CONFIDENTIALITY UNDER ARTICLE XI OR INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY UNDER ARTICLE X.
ops.newText: EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, EACH PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) THE AMOUNTS PAID OR PAYABLE BY SANOFI TO REVMED UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (B) USD 1,000,000. NOTWITHSTANDING THE FOREGOING, NOTHING IN THIS SECTION 14.5 IS INTENDED TO OR SHALL LIMIT OR RESTRICT THE FOLLOWING (THE "EXCLUDED CLAIMS"): THE INDEMNIFICATION RIGHTS OR OBLIGATIONS OF ANY PARTY UNDER SECTION 14.1 OR SECTION 14.2, OR DAMAGES AVAILABLE FOR A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS OBLIGATIONS RELATING TO CONFIDENTIALITY UNDER ARTICLE XI OR INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY UNDER ARTICLE X, OR A PARTY'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD. FOR CLARITY, SANOFI'S OBLIGATION TO PAY AMOUNTS DUE UNDER ARTICLE IX SHALL NOT CONSTITUTE DAMAGES SUBJECT TO THE FOREGOING CAP.
